title: Contrastive local learning in large nonlinear analog circuits
abstract: arXiv:2611.17561v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning in physical hardware promises to reduce training cost by colocating computation, memory and adaptation within device physics. Contrastive local learning networks (CLLNs) offer a compelling route: an electrical circuit relaxes to equilibrium in free and weakly clamped states, and each adaptive element updates from local voltage contrasts rather than backpropagated error signals. Yet whether nonlinear transistor implementations can scale beyond proof-of-concept circuits, and what design principles control that scaling, have remained unknown. Here we show that nonlinear analog circuits trained by contrastive local rules can learn larger machine-learning tasks and remain robust under hardware nonidealities. Using device-level circuit simulations, we systematically explore initialization, operating regime, loss-dependent clamping and training parameters, and scale CLLNs beyond ten thousand adaptive edges. translated_title: 大型非线性模拟电路中的对比局部学习
translated_abstract: 在物理硬件中进行机器学习，通过在器件物理中同时实现计算、存储与自适应，有望降低训练成本。对比局部学习网络提供了一条极具吸引力的途径：电路在自由态和弱钳制态下弛豫至平衡状态，每个自适应元件根据局部电压对比而非反向传播的误差信号进行更新。然而，非线性晶体管实现能否扩展到超越概念验证电路的规模，以及控制这种扩展的设计原则是什么，此前一直是未知的问题。本文表明，通过对比局部规则训练的非线性模拟电路能够学习更大规模的机器学习任务，并在硬件非理想性下保持稳健。利用器件级电路仿真，我们系统地探索了初始化、工作区域、依赖于损失的钳制方式以及训练参数，并将对比局部学习网络扩展至超过一万个自适应边。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明了基于对比局部规则训练的非线性模拟电路可以扩展到超过一万个自适应边的规模并学习更大型的机器学习任务，同时在硬件非理想条件下保持稳健性。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that nonlinear analog circuits trained by contrastive local learning rules can scale beyond ten thousand adaptive edges to learn larger machine learning tasks while remaining robust under hardware nonidealities.
